title: Started my journey with 5.5...
author: unlikely-ape
selftext:
After putting aside AI games and AI game dev for months and fighting the ghosts of cognitive dissonance i put aside my scepticism and started building. Im obviously very early into the process but i wanted to ask for feedback and how would you spend your time? At the moment a lot of parallel threads are working on different aspects of the game, but i am the blocker... I need to approve the merges, i still create the assets in blender (basically i get prompted by Opus... how the turned tabled...) except for humans, i suck at rigging but im great with hard surface. 

Anyhow, what do you guys do to better manage your time and efforts? 

I added a video of how my game plays as of now. 

Im still working on the map, the layout, the speed of which sunshine... ugh i mean coins are generated, the walking speed, attack speeds, dmg and hp of course... As you can see the jank is high but ive played this map so many times that i am blind to the issues... such as the early blockout of the cart in the middle of the town that should have been switched to the new model... also, the ragdoll jank is going to be fixed as soon as i learnt the ways from tutorials lol
